conditions.positive: a cheerful anime girl under cherry blossoms, detailed illustration, soft daylight
conditions.negative: worst quality, low quality, blurry, jpeg artifacts

source.post_measurement_changes: Restricted bypass hooks to xdna2 so CPU references remain independent; recomputed all four CPU chains and verified all 112 AIR replay outputs unchanged. Host BF16 wrapping was equivalently inlined, unsupported four-head CLI choice removed, full upstream revision and compile wall metadata added. Original sampler timing/image data retained.

counter_semantics.stage_wall: Existing StageMetric spans; compilation and setup appear on first use.
counter_semantics.stage_kernel_sync: Legacy field: NPUChain includes copies/sync; do not add to wall time.
counter_semantics.low_level: Timed original pyxrt sync/start/wait2 and numpy.copyto calls via AST wrappers; includes their Python crossing overhead.
counter_semantics.sync_bytes: Exact BO size per sync, cache-maintenance exposure, not discrete-device bus traffic.
counter_semantics.capture: Contains tensor capture/comparison overhead; excluded from performance samples.
counter_semantics.timing: Direct ComfyUI sampler, warm conditioning, VAE decode separate; not browser/API prompt wall.

cpu_oracle_recovery.reason: Initial AIR host-softmax bypass also affected the CPU oracle. Fixed by requiring runner_device=xdna2; all four CPU chains recomputed without probe hooks.

methodology.control: Current checkout QKV-chained 19-dispatch block, not the separately installed optimized production runtime.
methodology.sampler_timing: Three warmed samples per mode, order rotated each repeat. Includes all four steps/28 blocks, excludes capture/comparison, text/model setup and separate VAE decode. Not full browser/API prompt latency.
methodology.hotpath_timing: 12 actual Q/K/V cases, three warmups, 21 repeats per mode/case, alternate order. Whole QK/scale/softmax/AV wall including host preparation and output conversion.
methodology.profiling: Representative sampler profile is the measured run nearest its mode median; stage and XRT counters are nested, not additive.
methodology.sync_bytes: Exact synchronized BO sizes, not physical bus traffic or internal tile/memtile DMA volume.
methodology.accuracy: NRMS=L2(actual-reference)/L2(reference). Same-input replays and independent sampler trajectories are both recorded; block CPU oracle is BF16, not a separate stock-FP32 sampler.
methodology.warmup: AIR BOs/ELFs and model weights resident before sampler timing; all benchmark cases use persistent XRT runners.
methodology.limitations: One device/seed/prompt, three sampler repeats. Performance benefit is not numerical acceptance or a 12-second claim.

implementation.frontend: Direct MLIR-AIR via air.api; no Triton JIT for attention.
implementation.license: MIT; AIE microkernels Copyright (C) 2025 Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.
implementation.precision: BFP16-emulated BF16 matmul, BF16 block outputs and online-softmax state, conv_even; scale combined into exponential path. Not control-equivalent rounding.
implementation.mask_support: Explicitly rejected; fixed fixture is unmasked.
implementation.memtile_staging: Q/output plus separate K and V buffers; K/V alternated into one core staging buffer.
implementation.internal_restreaming: K/V streamed per 128-query group; no claim of zero internal DMA.

placement_findings.resolved_timeout: Distinct inbound K/V channels sharing one memtile allocation timed out; separate K and V memtile allocations executed repeatedly.
placement_findings.four_parallel_heads: Failed air-place-herds: no ShimNOCTile has sufficient DMA capacity for 1 input/0 output channels near centroid column 1.
placement_findings.measured_schedule: Two parallel heads, four query cores per head; one-head also executed, four-head unsupported.
